name: io.github.dockndevai/mcp-android
description: Control Android devices over ADB from AI agents — safe-by-default, read-only by default, audited.

environmentVariables.name: ANDROID_ADB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the adb binary (default: adb on PATH).

environmentVariables.name: ANDROID_SERIAL
environmentVariables.description: Target device serial from `adb devices`. Empty = the only connected device.

environmentVariables.name: ANDROID_PACKAGE_ALLOWLIST
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated package allowlist for launch/uninstall/clear. Empty = all.

environmentVariables.name: ANDROID_PROTECTED_PACKAGES
environmentVariables.description: Packages that can be launched/inspected but never uninstalled or data-cleared.

environmentVariables.name: ANDROID_ALLOW_INSTALL
environmentVariables.description: Enable install_apk / uninstall_app / clear_app_data (requires admin mode too).

environmentVariables.name: ANDROID_ALLOW_SHELL
environmentVariables.description: Enable run_shell (arbitrary adb shell; requires admin mode too).

environmentVariables.name: ANDROID_DRY_RUN
environmentVariables.description: Validate + log write/admin actions without executing them on the device.

environmentVariables.name: ANDROID_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Emit a JSON audit line to stderr per guarded operation (default true).
